summary: Enhance your hiring process with our Job Analysis and Job Descriptions training course. Learn effective strategies for creating clear, impactful job roles.
lede: Job analysis and job description training helps HR professionals, hiring managers, and workforce planners clarify role requirements before recruitment. Participants practise gathering role information through interviews, observation, questionnaires, and document review, then defining duties, competencies, and measurable selection criteria. They also learn to write clear, inclusive job descriptions and review them as roles change, supporting recruitment, onboarding, and performance evaluation.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who define, manage, or hire for roles across various sectors.
audience: Talent Acquisition and Workforce Planning Specialists
Organizational Development and HR Business Partners
Public Sector HR and Establishment Officers
NGO Project Leads and Program Managers
modules: Linking Job Descriptions to Recruitment and Selection
Competency-Based Job Design and Organizational Alignment
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of HR practices and experience in recruitment or people management roles.
